connector.name: Austrian Firmenbuch
connector.registryDescription: Austria's official company register (Firmenbuch) - master data, financials & ratios for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.agentic-firmenbuch.at over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jkbngb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Free API key from https://www.agentic-firmenbuch.at (request once with a verified email). Optional: clients with OAuth support can authenticate via the server's OAuth-protected-resource metadata instead.
